    ("\x1b7", "Private sequence \x1b7 should be stripped"),
    ("\x1b8", "Private sequence \x1b8 should be stripped"),
    ("\x1b0", "Private sequence \x1b0 should be stripped"),

    for token in tokens:
        if isinstance(token, str) and "\x1b" in token:
            print(f"FAILURE: {desc} - Sequence not stripped: {token!r}")

            annotation=get_typed_annotation(param.annotation, globalns),
